signals.title: HBM4 qualification concentration
signals.summary: Micron and SK hynix publicly connect HBM4 work to Rubin, while Samsung publicly establishes HBM4 production. That is a small named set, not proof that Rubin has a shortage or a sole source.

signals.title: Rack-scale integration exposure
signals.summary: Rubin combines several chips and networking components in a rack. More integration creates more qualification and assembly dependencies, but public sources do not identify a binding rack constraint.

signals.title: Liquid-cooling and power exposure
signals.summary: Rubin’s documented liquid-cooled design makes facility readiness part of deployment. IEA evidence supports local grid and connection exposure generally, not a Rubin-specific power shortage.

signals.title: Optical scale-out exposure
signals.summary: Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics adds optical components and co-packaged switch integration to the platform path. The map does not establish a specific photonics supplier or current capacity limit.
